inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to finish renegotiating the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions, warning of an indefinite nationwide strike if it does not. This is what happens when workers’ concerns are left unresolved for years: institutions can rely on their labor while delaying the commitments owed to them. Non-teaching staff deserve fair treatment, and the government should negotiate seriously rather than wait for workers to have to withdraw their labor to be heard.
